title: Customer Beta Success Playbook — Targeted Onboarding & Signal Pipeline
creator: Amira Patel
description: Create a repeatable, measurable playbook to onboard 10 pilot customers (mix of Hosted, Dedicated, Private) for the April beta. Focus areas: 1) rapid provisioning and connection checks, 2) targeted success criteria and signal collection (latency, cost per token, quality regressions), 3) feedback ingestion and closure loop to Product/Runtime teams. Goal: move 6/10 pilots to GA-readiness or clear non-adoption signal within 8 weeks.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding checklist completed for at least 10 pilot customers across deployment modes
Automated dashboard showing key signals (p99 latency, avg token cost, eval-run regressions) is live and populated for all pilots
Feedback intake flow routes issues to responsible owners with SLA (24h triage for P0/P1) and closed-loop summaries delivered weekly to pilot contacts
tasks: Draft pilot onboarding kit (technical steps, sample configs for Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
Build 'pilot signals' dashboard in Console (latency/cost/quality widgets) and verify for synthetic traffic
Define success & failure gates for staged expansion (canary -> cohort -> GA) and rollback criteria
Create templated customer kickoff deck and runbook for CSMs and Solutions Engineers
Instrument feedback form (structured) and integrate with Zendesk and Product feedback board
Schedule two internal readiness reviews with Eng, SRE, Console, and Security
Run a dry-run onboarding with internal partner team (simulate tenant creation, model pinning, and traffic)
Prepare release notes section targeting pilot customers (features, limitations, known issues, migration tips)
Establish weekly 'beta sync' meeting cadence and shared notes doc
Define reporting cadence and distribution list for pilot metrics and incident summaries
Create escalation matrix and contact list for on-call routing during pilot windows
Collect legal & compliance checklist for Private/VPC pilots (KMS, audit logs, data residency)
risks: Private/VPC pilots require manual network validation causing onboarding delays
Dashboard telemetry may miss eval regressions if eval set is not standardized across pilots
Dedicated capacity constraints could force model fallbacks and skew cost/latency signals
Insufficient CSM bandwidth to run deep post-kickoff enablement for every pilot
Unclear signal ownership between Console and Runtime teams could delay remediation
decisions: Canary cohort size set to 2 customers (one Hosted-heavy, one Dedicated) — expand only after 1 week of stable signals
Failure gate: p99 latency increase >30% sustained for 30m OR quality regression >5% on baseline eval prompts triggers immediate rollback to previous model variant
Feedback ingestion: use structured form with priority tags; P0/P1 create Zendesk ticket and notify on Slack #pilot-alerts channel
Rollout tracking: maintain a single source-of-truth sheet with customer status and next actions; access controlled to PM/SE/CS leads
